aiplayer.configuration.title: AI Player Configs
aiplayer.configuration.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. Off = AI module never starts, game stays vanilla (first gate when things break). Restart required
aiplayer.configuration.brainEnabled.tool: WARNING: not wired in this version, has no effect. Real decisions run in the sidecar agent process (see sidecar section); kept for a future mod-only mode
aiplayer.configuration.dataDirectory.too: Relative = relative to game dir, default aiplayer = <gamedir>/aiplayer/. Restart required; changing it does NOT migrate old data (memories/logs/agent deploy stay in place) - move manually
aiplayer.configuration.serverAddress: Target Server Address (blank = no auto login)
aiplayer.configuration.serverAddress.too: Auto login and reconnect both use this address. Applies instantly
aiplayer.configuration.autoLogin.tooltip: Auto-connect to serverAddress after reaching the title screen. Turn off to pick a server manually. Applies instantly
aiplayer.configuration.autoReconnect.too: After a disconnect (server crash/kick), retry every reconnectDelaySec so the bot returns on its own when the server is back. Applies instantly
aiplayer.configuration.reconnectDelaySec: Minimum gap between retries, avoids connection spam while the server is down. Range 5-600. Applies instantly
aiplayer.configuration.autoConnectMaxAtt: Max attempts for auto-login/reconnect within one process; resets after entering a world. When exhausted, a stuck disconnect screen returns to the title screen and auto-connect stops. Default 2, range 1-20. Applies instantly
aiplayer.configuration.pollIntervalMs.to: WARNING: not wired in this version, has no effect. Chat/state collection runs at the sidecar agent's own pace
aiplayer.configuration.logKeepDays.toolt: WARNING: not wired in this version, has no effect. Log cleanup is handled by the sidecar agent
aiplayer.configuration.verbose.tooltip: Logs extra info (client ready, etc.) to the game log. Applies instantly
aiplayer.configuration.controlEnabled.to: Port 8780 control plane (HTTP channel the agent uses to drive the game: /state /chat /actions ...). Restart required
aiplayer.configuration.controlHost.toolt: Keep 127.0.0.1 loopback: it can drive game actions directly, never expose it publicly. Restart required
aiplayer.configuration.controlPort.toolt: Default 8780 (avoids old bridge 8765 and agent console 8770). Range 1024-65535. Restart required
aiplayer.configuration.controlToken.tool: When set, requests must carry the X-AI-Token header. Empty is fine for loopback only; set it before exposing. Applies instantly
aiplayer.configuration.shutdownMessage.t: Auto-sent to the server on a clean exit. Max ~100 chars: server chat truncates longer messages, and @mention rendering adds characters (<=90 is safest). Applies instantly
aiplayer.configuration.networkEnabled.to: Outbound network gate for the built-in AI. Off = llm_chat/llm_ping rejected; the game itself is unaffected. Applies instantly
aiplayer.configuration.apiProvider.toolt: openai-compatible (default, appends /chat/completions to base_url) | deepseek | custom (base_url treated as full URL). Applies instantly
aiplayer.configuration.apiBaseUrl.toolti: DeepSeek = https://api.deepseek.com; OpenAI = https://api.openai.com/v1; local vLLM = http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1. Applies instantly
aiplayer.configuration.apiKeyEnv.tooltip: Read the key from this env var first (avoids plaintext on disk); falls back to apiKey below. Applies instantly
aiplayer.configuration.apiKey.tooltip: Prefer leaving empty and using the env var. The running sidecar agent uses its own key (PCL2/agent/config/keys.yaml), unrelated to this field; never echoed to logs. Applies instantly
aiplayer.configuration.apiHeadersJson.to: JSON object, e.g. {"HTTP-Referer":"https://example.com"}; parse failures are ignored and logged. Applies instantly
JSON object for provider-specific params, overrides same-named defaults; parse failures are ignored and logged. Applies instantly
aiplayer.configuration.apiTemperature.to: -1 = do not send (use server default). Range -1.0 ~ 2.0. Applies instantly
aiplayer.configuration.apiMaxTokens.tool: 0 = unlimited. Reasoning models also spend tokens on thinking, do not set too small. Applies instantly
aiplayer.configuration.permissions.fileM: full = read/write | readonly = read-only | off = disabled. Applied at assembly: gated actions are removed from the registry, so the model cannot see or waste rounds on them. Hot-swappable instantly
aiplayer.configuration.permissions.comma: Whether the command action (send /commands to the game) is allowed. Remote server /login flows depend on it - check your auto-login path before disabling. Hot-swappable instantly
aiplayer.configuration.permissions.selfT: When on, registers tool_run: the agent can chain existing actions into macros. Guardrails: steps must exist in the current registry (permission cascade) / no nested tool_run / <=64 steps. Hot-swappable instantly
aiplayer.configuration.permissions.gameA: full = all actions | safe = removes state-changing inputs (press/keys/click_slot/cont_button/screen_click*) | observe = also removes move/jump/sneak, pure observation + Q&A. Hot-swappable instantly
aiplayer.configuration.sidecar.enabled.t: On first start, deploys the bundled agent to <gamedir>/aiplayer-agent/<version>/ (upgrades keep keys.yaml/config/logs). Dual-client warning: if the viewer client also has this mod, enable it ONLY on the AI client, otherwise two agents run. Restart required
aiplayer.configuration.sidecar.deployDir: Agent deploy root (relative to game dir). Usually no need to change. Restart required
aiplayer.configuration.sidecar.autoStart: ensure_running semantics: if port 8770 already has an instance (e.g. started via 启动agent.bat), it is reused, not duplicated. Restart required
aiplayer.configuration.sidecar.launchMod: attach = close the self-started agent when the game exits | detach = agent keeps running after the game exits (memory upkeep/scheduled research). Restart required
aiplayer.configuration.sidecar.pythonPat: Bare program name (via PATH) or absolute path. Restart required
aiplayer.configuration.sidecar.watchdogI: Restarts the agent on failed health checks (exponential backoff, capped at 60s). Range 0-3600. Restart required
